§6Machine type: §aBlast Furnace§r

Blaze Pyrotheum feeds celestial forges. Soulsteel wrought, flame-bound cosmic rite.
Excels at continuous processing, but also handles conventional recipes.
Blast furnace temp gradually increases in Passive Mode.
Recipe changes recalculate extra heat based on structure tier.
Power consumption decreases by 10% per 900K above recipe temperature threshold.
Max parallels: 4096x in Normal Mode; 256x in Passive Mode.
Processes recipes at 390% speed; Glass tier restricts Energy Hatch tier.
Upgrade machine and build additional structure to unlock additional functions.
Do not open the cabin door while the machine is running!

[note]Hatches[/note]: Input Bus, Input Hatch, Output Bus, Output Hatch, Energy Hatch
[note]Structure[/note]: Heating Coils (the coil tier matters); Tiered glass (limits the energy hatch tier); Neutronium Frame Boxes; Naquadah Alloy Frame Boxes; Cosmic Neutronium Frame Boxes; Compact Fusion Coils; the casings in the optional task.
Use a Hologram Projector (or the NEI structure preview) to see and auto-build the structure.

[note]Controller recipe[/note]: Assembly Line, UHV
